MODIFY src/engine/profile-detector.ts. Read ancestor `.gwrkrc.json` in worktrees and delegate merging to `src/domain/profile-policy.js`. Tests: src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Legacy workspace test runner changes — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:431-442
  EXPECTED: With no design and no matching workspace override, a Python workspace keeps its detected toolchain.test of "pytest".
  ACTUAL: The ancestor project.toolchain.test of "vitest" replaces "pytest". The parent revision returns "pytest" for the same fixture.
  FIX: Preserve legacy detection when ancestor config has no design selection. Add a gate case with a TypeScript parent test runner and an unregistered Python workspace.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Explicit workspace resolution skips root settings — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:371-393,460-477
  EXPECTED: resolveWorkspaceProfile(root, "services/api") applies the supplied root's design and matching workspace overrides when the workspace config only declares project.name.
  ACTUAL: The workspace config triggers an early return. The result has no design, keeps FastAPI instead of Django, and drops toolchain.build: null.
  FIX: Resolve the supplied root's configuration explicitly for the two-argument API. Merge the matching workspace overrides over detected fields and preserve workspace or root design. Add a gate case with a workspace-local config that only declares project.name.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/profile-policy.ts — In `resolveWorkspacePolicyProfile`, return `detectedWorkspace` when both `rootConfig?.project?.design` and the longest matching workspace override are absent.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — In the two-argument `resolveWorkspaceProfile` overload, detect the workspace with its local config and skip ancestor discovery. Read the supplied root’s `.gwrkrc.json` explicitly. Validate its design, toolchain and workspace entries with the existing schemas. Apply the longest matching workspace override through `resolveWorkspacePolicyProfile`. Use design precedence of workspace entry, workspace-local `project.design`, then root `project.design`. Preserve explicit `toolchain.build: null`.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts — Add two regressions to the suite already run by `specs/044-architecture-aware-policy/gates/phase-01.sh`. Assert `detectProfile` keeps `toolchain.test: "pytest"` for an unregistered Python workspace under a TypeScript root configured with `"vitest"` and no design. Assert `resolveWorkspaceProfile(root, "services/api")` returns the root design, Python, Django and `toolchain.build: null` when the workspace config declares only `project.name`. Run the phase gate before and after the fixes. Verify both cases fail first and pass afterward.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Registered workspace changes legacy profile — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:431-443,460-490
  EXPECTED: detectProfile("services/api") preserves FastAPI and pytest when neither the root nor the matching workspace selects a design. Revision e82011ac returns those values.
  ACTUAL: A matching workspace entry with stack.framework: "Django" activates ancestor merging. The result has Django and inherits the TypeScript root's toolchain.test: "vitest".
  FIX: Apply ancestor policy on the detectProfile path only when the root or the matching workspace selects a design. Add a gate case for a registered Python workspace with a framework override and a TypeScript root runner.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Legacy workspace resolver adds inherited toolchain — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:549-576
  EXPECTED: resolveWorkspaceProfile(cwd, root, config) returns the legacy type, stack and layout for a matching entry when neither root nor workspace selects a design.
  ACTUAL: workspaceProfileMetadata adds toolchain.test: "vitest" from project.toolchain even though the workspace only configures stack.framework.
  FIX: Preserve the legacy three-argument profile when there is no design selection. Add a gate assertion for its full return shape.

NEW src/domain/profile-policy.ts. Implement pure `mergeProfileOverrides` and `resolveWorkspacePolicyProfile`. Tests: src/domain/profile-policy.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Root runner replaces the workspace runner — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/domain/profile-policy.ts:40-45,84-89
  EXPECTED: A Python workspace with test: "pytest" inherits the root design and its own build: null override. Its test runner stays "pytest" when the root uses "vitest".
  ACTUAL: resolveWorkspacePolicyProfile returns toolchain: { primary: "ruff", test: "vitest", build: null }.
  FIX: Treat root runner settings as defaults for workspace resolution. Preserve the detected workspace runner unless its matching workspace entry sets one. Add a unit case with a TypeScript root and a Python workspace that sets only build: null.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/profile-policy.ts — In `resolveWorkspacePolicyProfile`, merge toolchain fields in this order: root defaults, detected workspace, longest matching workspace entry. Preserve `null` and keep `mergeProfileOverrides` precedence intact. In `src/domain/profile-policy.test.ts`, add root `test: "vitest"` to the Python fixture whose workspace entry sets only `build: null`. Assert root design, `test: "pytest"` and `build: null`.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — Keep `requireDesign: true` on the ancestor lookup in `resolveDetectedProfile`. When neither the ancestor root nor the matching workspace entry selects a design, return the detected profile. Keep the unregistered Python case in `src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts` asserting `pytest` under a no-design TypeScript root configured with `vitest`.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — In the two-argument overload, detect the workspace with `detectProfileInDirectory(workspace, false)` and read the supplied root’s `.gwrkrc.json` even when the workspace has local config. Use `applyWorkspaceConfig` to validate the root design, toolchain and workspace entries. Apply design precedence from the matching entry to the local project to the root. Keep the name-only fixture in `src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts` asserting root design, Python, Django and `build: null`.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — Apply the ancestor design guard to registered workspaces too. Keep the registered case in `src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts` asserting FastAPI and pytest when the matching entry sets Django and the no-design root sets vitest.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — In `workspaceProfileMetadata`, return `{}` when both validated designs are absent. Keep the three-argument regression in `src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts` using `toStrictEqual({ type: "nodejs", stack: { framework: "Django" }, layout: "flat" })` with root `test: "vitest"`.
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts — Add a two-argument fixture with root design and `test: "vitest"`, local `project.toolchain.test: "pytest"` and matching entry `build: null`. Omit pytest detection signals so only local config supplies the runner. Assert root design, `test: "pytest"` and `build: null`. Run `specs/044-architecture-aware-policy/gates/phase-01.sh` before and after the toolchain fix. Verify both new runner regressions fail before the fix and all cases pass afterward.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Root custom test command overrides workspace runner — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/domain/profile-policy.ts:40-45,84-96
  EXPECTED: With root design and project.toolchain.testCommand: "pnpm exec vitest run {files}", a Python workspace with workspaces["services/api"].toolchain.test: "pytest" resolves getTestCommand(profile, ["test_api.py"]) to "pytest test_api.py -v".
  ACTUAL: profile.toolchain contains both test: "pytest" and the inherited testCommand. getTestCommand returns "pnpm exec vitest run test_api.py" because it reads testCommand before test.
  FIX: Resolve test and testCommand together across toolchain layers. A higher-precedence runner must suppress a lower-precedence custom command while preserving explicit workspace commands and test: null. Add a phase gate assertion for the emitted command.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Two-argument resolver inherits the root runner without design — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:498-510
  EXPECTED: resolveWorkspaceProfile(root, "services/api") keeps Python's inferred pytest runner when the root sets test: "vitest" and the workspace entry only sets stack.framework: "Django". Neither selects a design.
  ACTUAL: The two-argument resolver sets toolchain.test: "vitest". getTestCommand returns "pnpm vitest run test_api.py --reporter=verbose". Direct detectProfile returns "pytest test_api.py -v". The legacy three-argument resolver adds no toolchain for the same config.
  FIX: Preserve the detected workspace toolchain and matching workspace overrides without importing root toolchain defaults when no design applies. Add a two-argument gate fixture with a Python pyproject.toml and no explicit pytest detection signal.
